name: Galeazzo di Tarsia
bio: Galeazzo di Tarsia (c. 1520-1553) was a Calabrian nobleman, baron of Belmonte, and one of the notable Petrarchan poets of the sixteenth-century south of Italy. He lived in the kingdom of Naples and wrote his lyrics in the manner of Petrarch.

His sonnets, among them poems addressed to Vittoria Colonna, circulated only in manuscript and were first printed in 1617. The sonnet here is taken from the Oxford Book of Italian Verse (1910), as transcribed on Italian Wikisource.

poems.title: Già corsi l’Alpi gelide e canute
poems.author: Galeazzo di Tarsia
poems.collection: The Oxford Book of Italian Verse (ed. Lucas, 1910)
poems.text:
Già corsi l’Alpi gelide e canute,
Mal fida siepe a le tue rive amate;
Or sento, Italia mia, l’aure odorate,
E l’äer pien di vita e di salute.

Quante m’ha dato Amor, lasso! ferute,
Membrando la fatal vostra beltate,
Chiuse valli, alti poggi ed ombre grate,
Da’ ciechi figli tuoi mal conosciute!

O felice colui che un breve e colto
Terren fra voi possiede, e gode un rivo,
Un pomo, un antro, e di fortuna un volto!

Ebbi i riposi e le mie paci a schivo
(O giovanil desio fallace e stolto!);
Or vo piangendo che di lor son privo.
